meta.source: local clone corpus/dfhack_full (main repo @ develop, scripts submodule pinned ccead2ef)

counts.note: fix-occupancy C++ plugin is cataloged inside the fix/occupancy entry (backend)

family_legend.dangling-refs: references to deleted/missing objects, one-sided links
family_legend.stuck-flags: occupancy/job/position flags desynced from reality, freezing tiles+items
family_legend.arrival-deadlock: units, caravans, squads, wildlife wedged off-map or mid-transition
family_legend.faction-state-poisoning: entity diplomacy/enemy status corrupted into permanent war
family_legend.unit-ai-deadlock: per-unit AI, need, or physiology wedged in an uninterruptible loop
family_legend.missing-init: engine never initializes a field; downstream consumers read garbage
family_legend.generation-defect: wrong data written at creation time or wrong rule applied
family_legend.lost-updates: engine fails to propagate or persist a value it did write
family_legend.resource-degeneration: runaway updates or unbounded lists degrade the simulation
family_legend.display-defect: cosmetic/UI defects, wrong or missing rendering

fixes.name: fix/archery-practice
fixes.defect: DF prevented archery practice from starting based on quiver inventory position and mono-stack training ammo (fixed upstream in DF 53.01)
fixes.manifestation: Ranged squad members never initiate archery practice
fixes.mechanism: Moves quivers to the end of each training unit's inventory and splits training ammo stacks inside quivers (>=25) so each unit can hold multiple stacks

fixes.name: fix/blood-del
fixes.defect: Entity trade manifests include blood, ichor, and goo as extract resources
fixes.manifestation: Future caravans bring barrels full of blood/ichor/goo that are unusable
fixes.mechanism: Erases BLOOD/ICHOR/GOO (and nil-mat) entries from every entity's resources.misc_mat.extracts vectors

fixes.name: fix/civil-war
fixes.defect: Parent-civ diplomacy relation stuck negative against your own government
fixes.manifestation: Civil war: no caravans, no migrants, dwarf-on-dwarf hostility
fixes.mechanism: Sets any diplomacy state entry where group_id == own civ with relation > 0 back to 0

fixes.name: fix/codex-pages
fixes.defect: DF bug 9268: written content created without start/end page fields initialized
fixes.manifestation: Codices, quires, scrolls exist with zero/undefined page counts; unreadable or blank books
fixes.mechanism: Detects written content with missing page data and generates weighted-random page-count information (cannot recover lost real data)

fixes.name: fix/corrupt-equipment
fixes.defect: DF bug 11014: deleted items left in military equipment lists; wrong-type items stored in equipment lists (crash sources)
fixes.manifestation: Crashes during raids/large military operations, sometimes within a short window after load
fixes.mechanism: Scans squad equipment lists, removes entries whose items are deleted or of the wrong type (does not yet fix wrong items assigned to squad members)
fixes.mode: manual, recommended on repeat every 100 ticks during military ops

fixes.name: fix/corrupt-jobs
fixes.defect: Units can carry a current_job whose id is -1 (deleted/corrupt job object)
fixes.manifestation: Crashes tied to corrupt jobs on affected units
fixes.mechanism: Nulls out unit.job.current_job where job.id == -1; hooks SC_MAP_LOADED so every fort load self-heals

fixes.name: fix/dead-units
fixes.defect: Dead units are never culled; the dead list grows unbounded (~3000+) and vanilla offers no removal UI
fixes.manifestation: Migrant waves stop arriving; burrow UI reports inflated occupancy from long-dead units
fixes.mechanism: Scrubs uninteresting dead units (slaughtered animals, nameless enemies, dead foreigners) from the active vector and burrow assignments, keeping recent deaths (1 month) for context

fixes.name: fix/drop-webs
fixes.defect: DF bug 595: webs left floating mid-air (e.g. webbed tree chopped down) never fall
fixes.manifestation: Webs hover in open space, unreachable and uncollectable
fixes.mechanism: Converts floating web items into projectiles with fall flags so they land on a valid surface; -all variant drops webs stuck in branches too

fixes.name: fix/dry-buckets
fixes.defect: Interrupted water-hauling jobs leave buckets full of water flagged as used; buckets can also end up over-full blocking wells
fixes.manifestation: Discarded full buckets unavailable for lye-making etc.; well operations blocked
fixes.mechanism: Deletes contained water from idle buckets not in a job and not inside an active well

fixes.name: fix/empty-wheelbarrows
fixes.defect: DF bug 6074 family: rocks become stuck inside wheelbarrows with no active hauling job
fixes.manifestation: Wheelbarrows lie around permanently loaded with rocks; unusable for new hauling
fixes.mechanism: Moves contained items to the ground (removing their job refs first) from any wheelbarrow not in use

fixes.name: fix/engravings
fixes.defect: Constructing a wall/floor over an engraved tile corrupts the tile/engraving state (tile no longer SMOOTH, engraving record orphaned)
fixes.manifestation: Tiles permanently unengravable
fixes.mechanism: Validates every engraving against its tile attributes (special==SMOOTH, floor/wall flag consistency) and deletes mismatched engraving records

fixes.name: fix/general-strike
fixes.defect: Planted seeds lose their in_building flag; replant jobs can never find them
fixes.manifestation: Mass job-cancellation spam; dwarves stop accepting work entirely (the 'general strike bug')
fixes.mechanism: Re-flags seeds sitting on farm plots as in_building and forces their building_item use_mode to PERM

fixes.name: fix/loyaltycascade
fixes.defect: A citizen death can flip a unit's histfig entity links (FORMER_MEMBER + ENEMY vs own civ), making dwarves enemies of their own civilization
fixes.manifestation: Loyalty cascade: intra-fort civil war, dwarves fighting dwarves map-wide
fixes.mechanism: Detects renegade units (former-member/enemy links to own entity), re-converts them to the fort entity, and halts citizen-involved fights

fixes.name: fix/noexert-exhaustion
fixes.defect: DF bug 8389: Individual Combat Drill ignores the NOEXERT caste tag and NOEXERT units have no recovery path (exhaustion only accumulates, ~50 per 9 ticks)
fixes.manifestation: Vampires, necromancers, intelligent undead get permanently stuck 'Tired', debuffed out of military training
fixes.mechanism: Zeroes the exhaustion counter (counters2.exhaustion) of all NOEXERT units; not permanent, must re-run (every ~350 ticks) via control-panel

fixes.name: fix/occupancy (backend: fix-occupancy plugin)
fixes.defect: DF bug 3499: map occupancy/building flags desync from actual entities (phantom occupancy)
fixes.manifestation: Undeserved 'unit blocking tile', 'building present', 'items occupying site' failures
fixes.mechanism: C++ plugin (plugins/fix-occupancy.cpp) recomputes and clears stale unit/item/building occupancy flags map-wide or per-tile; Lua wrapper adds dry-run

fixes.name: fix/ownership
fixes.defect: DF bug 6578 family: one-sided ownership links (unit.owned_items lists an item lacking the owner ref; zone remembers owner the unit forgot)
fixes.manifestation: Units stuck in endless 'Store owned item' jobs; bedrooms/offices/dining rooms/tombs unused and unclaimable; noble room requirements never satisfied
fixes.mechanism: Erases invalid item claims from unit owned_items and relinks zone<->unit room ownership refs
fixes.mode: opt-in automatic (daily when enabled in control-panel) + manual

fixes.name: fix/population-cap
fixes.defect: Engine only updates the civ's recorded population when a dwarven caravan successfully leaves the map; arrays can also be undersized vs tasks
fixes.manifestation: Endless migrant waves long after the population cap is exceeded (esp. if no caravan ever leaves)
fixes.mechanism: Resizes civ activity_stats/knowledge vectors to match tasks, and sets activity_stats.population to max(current, tasks)

fixes.name: fix/protect-nicks
fixes.defect: v50.x DF sets unit nicknames without propagating them to the historical figure, so they are not persisted everywhere
fixes.manifestation: Nicknames lost on save/reload or after kills/retirement; missing from legends and engravings
fixes.mechanism: Daily event loop re-applies each unit's nickname via dfhack.units.setNickname (writes to the histfig as pre-Steam DF did); persists enable state per-site

fixes.name: fix/retrieve-units
fixes.defect: DF bug 10075 family: units flagged pending-entry (incoming / merchant / invades but inactive) never actually enter the map
fixes.manifestation: Stuck [SIEGE] tags from invisible armies; forgotten beasts, wildlife packs, and caravans that never appear
fixes.mechanism: Clears inactive/incoming flags, sets move_state/can_swap, and inserts missing units into the active vector

fixes.name: fix/sleepers
fixes.defect: DF bug 6798: camp army_controller spawns lack the ALARM_INTRUDER flag, so camp sleepers have no wake condition
fixes.manifestation: Adventure-mode sleeping units never wake no matter what you do to them
fixes.mechanism: Sets ALARM_INTRUDER on CAMP-goal army controllers of active units

fixes.name: fix/stable-temp
fixes.defect: Free items sitting at temperatures off-environment keep triggering temperature update passes every tick
fixes.manifestation: Severe FPS drain from temperature churn (esp. with magma/persistent hot items)
fixes.mechanism: Sets every free item's temperature (and contaminants, recursively including contents) into equilibrium with the environment, halting updates; pair with tweak fast-heat to maintain

fixes.name: fix/stuck-instruments
fixes.defect: DF bug 9485: instruments picked up for a performance reference activity entries that were simulated away/deleted; some have in_job with zero refs
fixes.manifestation: Instruments stuck permanently in a job that no longer exists, unusable on the ground
fixes.mechanism: Deletes dead ACTIVITY_EVENT refs, clears in_job when no refs remain; dry-run support

fixes.name: fix/stuck-merchants
fixes.defect: DF bug 9593: caravan merchants flagged merchant but stuck inactive off the map edge, never entering
fixes.manifestation: Caravan arrival announcement fires but no merchants ever enter the map
fixes.mechanism: Sets flags1.left on inactive merchant units so the game finalizes their departure (must not run while merchants are on-map; not repeat-safe)

fixes.name: fix/stuck-squad
fixes.defect: Mission squads' world-map armies lose their controller (controller_id != 0 with no controller object), losing navigation
fixes.manifestation: Squads sent on missions get stuck on the world map, unable to return home
fixes.mechanism: Event-driven: when a returning messenger/squad passes the stuck army, re-links controllers up the controller chain so the lost squad is rescued and brought home; notifies via gui/notify

fixes.name: fix/stuck-worship
fixes.defect: DF bug 10918: prayer-need satisfaction credit sticks to one deity; unmet prayer needs for others trigger an uninterruptible activity
fixes.manifestation: Dwarves locked in a permanent purple 'Worship!' state, effectively useless
fixes.mechanism: Shuffles/transfers need focus_level credit between met and unmet prayer targets so the next prayer rotates deities

fixes.name: fix/stuck-written-materials
fixes.defect: DF bug 9485 family: books/quires/scrolls retain specific_refs to deleted jobs (visitor joining fort, squads returning with written materials)
fixes.manifestation: Written materials permanently stuck in dead jobs; cannot be hauled or interacted with
fixes.mechanism: Removes dead job refs, clears in_job for items with no live job (checking container chains); module + dry-run

fixes.name: fix/stuckdoors
fixes.defect: Incorrect map occupancy flags (e.g. from improper teleporting of units/items) hold doors open
fixes.manifestation: Door frozen in 'open' state, never closes, no visible cause
fixes.mechanism: For each door with close_timer != 0, checks for units/stray items on the door tile and clears the bogus occupancy so the door can shut

fixes.name: fix/symbol-unstick
fixes.defect: Artifact symbol claims (entity artifact_claims + artifact entity_claims) survive the noble position being vacated
fixes.manifestation: Noble symbol artifact cannot be re-designated to a new position holder
fixes.mechanism: For the selected artifact claimed by the civ with claim_type Symbol whose position assignment has histfig == -1, erases both claim records

fixes.name: fix/wildlife
fixes.defect: DF bug 12921: wildlife wave members get stuck trying to leave the map and are never counted back into the regional population
fixes.manifestation: New wildlife waves cannot spawn until the old group leaves/dies; wildlife activity halts entirely
fixes.mechanism: Detects stuck leavers and moves them off-map while correctly incrementing regional population counters; background monitor removes after 7 days stuck
fixes.mode: manual or opt-in automatic (NOT default: some players keep wildlife captive)

fixes.name: quickfix.set_entity_race_references
fixes.defect: World entities can exist with race == -1 (never set)
fixes.manifestation: DF crashes when such an entity tries to send a caravan
fixes.mechanism: On DFHack load, finds the dwarf race (first OCCURS_AS_ENTITY_RACE raw) and assigns it to every entity with race -1; ships in default onLoad init

fixes.name: quickfix.repair_site_id
fixes.defect: Reclaimed fortresses never get plotinfo.site_id assigned until the first save
fixes.manifestation: Anything needing the site id breaks after reclaiming a fort
fixes.mechanism: On map load, if site_id == -1 but fortress_site is set, restores site_id from fortress_site.id; ships in default onMapLoad init

fixes.name: fixveins (plugin)
fixes.defect: Building/removing constructions on mineral floors (and periodic farm plot/road passes) destroys the mineral, reverting tiles to layer stone; tiletypes misuse can leave invalid mineral-inclusion refs
fixes.manifestation: Ores and gems silently disappear under buildings; broken embark tiles with phantom inclusion refs
fixes.mechanism: C++ plugin restores affected tile material to its original mineral via block mineral events and removes invalid inclusion references
fixes.mode: manual (tagged unavailable for current DF versions)

fixes.name: tweak adamantine-cloth-wear
fixes.defect: DF bug 6481: adamantine clothing wears out while worn (should not)
fixes.manifestation: Legendary cloth-armor decays like rags
fixes.mechanism: Vmethod hook prevents wear accumulation on adamantine items while worn

fixes.name: tweak animaltrap-reuse
fixes.defect: Built animal traps never unload caught vermin, so they cannot be re-baited
fixes.manifestation: Traps with vermin sit dead in builds; trapping pipeline stalls
fixes.mechanism: Moves caught vermin from built traps into stockpiled traps so they can be automatically re-baited and reused

fixes.name: tweak craft-age-wear
fixes.defect: DF bug 6003: crafted items never gain wear over time
fixes.manifestation: Cloth/leather crafts persist forever, breaking item-age realism/economy
fixes.mechanism: Adds one wear level to cloth/leather crafts every 20 in-game years

fixes.name: tweak drawbridge-tiles
fixes.defect: Raised bridges render with the same tiles as lowered ones in ASCII mode
fixes.manifestation: Cannot visually distinguish raised bridges in ASCII
fixes.mechanism: Renders raised bridges with distinct tiles

fixes.name: tweak eggs-fertile
fixes.defect: No indication whether eggs are fertile
fixes.manifestation: Players cannot tell which egg clutchs will hatch before deciding to forbid/cook them
fixes.mechanism: Displays an indicator on fertile eggs

fixes.name: tweak fast-heat
fixes.defect: Temperature updates can take arbitrarily long per item, cascading FPS loss with many items (companion to fix/stable-temp)
fixes.manifestation: FPS drain while items equilibrate with environment temperature
fixes.mechanism: Caps temperature-change granularity so 1 degree is crossed in <=100 ticks when updating from environment temperature

fixes.name: tweak flask-contents
fixes.defect: DF bug 4914: filled waterskins/flasks/vials are not named by contents, unlike barrels/bins/cages
fixes.manifestation: All flasks look identical in lists; cannot see what they hold
fixes.mechanism: Names filled containers according to their contents

fixes.name: tweak named-codices
fixes.defect: Books render with the default material description instead of their titles
fixes.manifestation: Every book reads as 'chestnut-bound quire' style text; libraries unnavigable
fixes.mechanism: Displays written-work titles in place of material descriptions

fixes.name: tweak partial-items
fixes.defect: Partially-consumed items (e.g. hospital cloth) show no fraction indicator
fixes.manifestation: Cannot see how much of a partially-used item remains
fixes.mechanism: Displays percentages on partially-consumed items

fixes.name: tweak realistic-melting
fixes.defect: DF bug 6027: melting returns metal at wrong/unfair amortized amounts with fixed 0.3-bar granularity
fixes.manifestation: Melting yields nonsensical metal quantities, exploitable or lossy
fixes.mechanism: Normalizes melt return to 95% of production cost minus 10% per wear level, with randomized per-item returns inside the 0.3 granularity

fixes.name: tweak reaction-gloves
fixes.defect: DF bug 6273: custom reactions produce gloves with wrong handedness (all left or all right)
fixes.manifestation: Reaction-made gloves unwearable; military uniform fits fail
fixes.mechanism: Makes reaction products emit gloves in correct left/right sets

fixes.name: preserve-rooms (plugin)
fixes.defect: Citizens leaving the map (raids etc.) lose all zone assignments; bedrooms/offices/dining rooms/tombs go unassigned and claimable by others
fixes.manifestation: Rooms silently reassigned while owner is away on missions
fixes.mechanism: Remembers assignments of off-map units and restores them (incl. noble-role rooms) on return

fixes.name: preserve-tombs (plugin)
fixes.defect: Tomb assignments are dropped when the assigned unit dies
fixes.manifestation: Noble tombs detach from the corpse and get reassigned
fixes.mechanism: Persists tomb assignments across the unit's death

fixes.name: uniform-unstick
fixes.defect: Multiple units claim the same equipment item; uniform claims conflict and never reevaluate
fixes.manifestation: Soldiers stuck unable to equip; items held by ghost claims
fixes.mechanism: Prompts affected military units to reevaluate uniforms, dropping conflicting worn-item claims (unassigns items from units not wearing them)

fixes.name: caravan unload
fixes.defect: Merchant pack animals become disconnected from their owners
fixes.manifestation: Endless unloading loop at the depot; caravan never finishes
fixes.mechanism: Reconnects merchant pack animals to their owners so the unload state machine can complete (also offers extend/happy/leave adjustments)
